syllabus_extract: Introduction to communication system. Purpose, technical details and types of various communication systems.
specific_objectives: 26.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of basic signal transmission diagrams; Safety: No live equipment handling; Instructor supervision: Monitor understanding of theory only.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a communication system?
Define the term 'signal' in the context of communication.
List two types of communication systems based on transmission medium.

development.content:
Basic theory of communication
Purpose of communication systems
Key components of a system
Signal transmission process

Technical details of analog systems
Technical details of digital systems
Wired vs wireless transmission
Modulation techniques overview

Classification of communication systems
Terrestrial vs satellite communication
Fiber optic basics
Radio frequency spectrum usage

summary_questions: Explain the difference between analog and digital communication systems.
Describe the role of modulation in a communication system.
Identify three types of communication systems based on the transmission medium.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the safety precautions required when handling embedded system components, to be discussed in LP 08.
